verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents low-effort ways to accept online payments: no-code Payment Links, a pre-built Hosted Payment Page, and an end-to-end quickstart. Its sandbox offers instant self-serve signup, but that only covers test payments, not real ones. Live acceptance requires applying for a business account, with eligibility checks, approval that is not guaranteed, and features that vary by country, so going live within a day of signing up is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of production onboarding/KYC approval time, evidence that card acceptance is enabled immediately on approval, independent or hands-on reports of same-day go-live.
